headlines.title: Advertisers Must Find the Friend Who Pays for Everyone: PayPal Ads’ Asaf Davidov
headlines.summary: Advertisers have spent a fortune trying to figure out who influences purchase decisions. PayPal Ads has a novel suggestion: Find the person who's always stuck paying for dinner while everyone else promises to Venmo them later. That person might be worth a lot more to marketers than their dinner companions, according to Asaf Davidov, head of global ad insights and analytics at PayPal Ads. In an interview with Beet.TV contributor David Kaplan at the Beet.

headlines.title: Aqua Finance Names Michelle Gill as Chief Executive Officer
headlines.summary: WAUSAU, Wis., Oct. 19, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Aqua Finance ("Aqua" or the "Company"), a fast-growing consumer lending platform within Apollo’s origination ecosystem, announced the appointment of Michelle Gill as Chief Executive Officer. Gill joins Aqua Finance from PayPal, where she served as Executive Vice President and General Manager of Small Business and Financial Services.

description: PayPal Holdings, Inc. operates a technology platform that enables digital payments for merchants and consumers worldwide. The company operates a two-sided network at scale that connects merchants and consumers that enables its customers to connect, transact, and send and receive payments through online and in person, as well as transfer and withdraw funds using various funding sources, such as bank accounts, PayPal or Venmo account balance, consumer credit and debit products, credit and debit cards, and cryptocurrencies, as well as other stored value products, including gift cards and eligible rewards. It provides payment solutions under the PayPal, PayPal Credit, Braintree, Venmo, Xoom, Hyperwallet, Honey, and Paidy names. The company was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in San Jose, California.
